title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Holder and Booking Party for Remittances
content:
## Clause

A remittance is applied to a Dangerous Goods Acceptance file only where the customer holding the acceptance is also the booking party of the booking under which the goods travel. For an acceptance whose holder is a different party from that booking party, the desk books no remittance at all, and the amount applied is 0.00.

## Evidence

Both parties are read from the line's records: the holder from the acceptance, the booking party from the booking the acceptance names.

## Cases

| Holder of the acceptance | Booking party of the carrying booking | Remittance applied |
|---|---|---|
| a forwarder | the same forwarder | yes |
| a forwarder | the cargo owner that booked the space | no, 0.00 |
| a cargo owner | the same cargo owner | yes |

## Point of judgement

**The acceptance holder sends a remittance for goods booked by another party.** Nothing is booked on that acceptance.
